senses.sense_definition: A surname of Scottish Gaelic origin.

examples.text: The media mogul Rupert <w>Murdoch</w> built one of the largest news corporations in the world.
Professor <w>Murdoch</w> announced that the final examination would take place on Friday afternoon.

senses.sense_definition: A suburb of Perth, Western Australia, within the City of Melville.

examples.text: Many university students commute daily to the campus located in <w>Murdoch</w>.
The train line connects the central district directly to the suburb of <w>Murdoch</w>.

senses.sense_definition: An unincorporated community in Warren County, Ohio, United States.

examples.text: The rural community of <w>Murdoch</w> lies within Hamilton Township in southwestern Ohio.
Several historic homes remain preserved around the small settlement of <w>Murdoch</w>.
